title: Chapter 97 — The Document & Quote Engine
intro: Quotes at speed, communications, trade documents, and verification checklists.

sections.title: AI-Powered Quoting
sections.content:
Use AI to draft quotes faster. Feed it the customer's requirements from discovery — products, quantities, delivery preferences — and have it generate a formatted quote with specs, pricing, and terms in minutes instead of thirty.

But always verify. Every model number. Every price. Every delivery date. AI generates the draft. You verify the details. The customer sees a perfect quote, fast. They do not see the verification step — they just see speed and accuracy.

sections.title: Communication Templates
sections.content:
AI can generate personalized follow-up emails, thank-you notes, promotion alerts, and referral asks in seconds. The key is editing for your voice. A template that sounds generic does more harm than good. A template that sounds like you — personalized with the customer's name, their product, their specific situation — builds the relationship.

Build a library of AI-generated templates for every stage of the sale: post-visit, post-quote, post-delivery, referral ask, anniversary check-in. Customize each one before sending.

sections.title: The Verification Checklist
sections.content:
Before any AI-generated document leaves your hands, check: are the model numbers correct and current? Is the pricing accurate against today's system? Are the delivery dates realistic? Are the installation requirements complete? Does the tone match your voice?

One wrong model number on a quote creates a return. One wrong price creates a margin loss. One wrong delivery date creates a complaint. The five-minute verification saves hours of cleanup.
